summary: Connect SEO, content and social campaigns to measurable actions. Explore the five-day training and its practical planning exercises.
lede: Internet and social media marketing connects website, search and social activity to audience actions. For digital marketing professionals coordinating campaigns, it covers audience segmentation, SEO search intent, channel-specific content planning, conversion copy and campaign measurement using RACE and UTM tracking. Exercises include auditing channel handoffs, preparing an editorial calendar and landing-page brief, and reviewing channel performance in an Excel scorecard.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with digital channels and need to coordinate website, search and social activity more effectively.
modules: SEO Search Intent and Website Pages
Content Strategy Workshop and Editorial Calendar
AIDA Landing Pages and Conversion Copy
Paid Social Campaign Structure and Budgeting
prerequisites: Working familiarity with digital marketing, website content or social media campaign activity is expected. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel for the scorecard exercise; no personal advertising or social platform account is required.
